scope.title: One verified write owner for a hot file
scope.source: in-memory claim + real per-file mutation queue fixtures (no live provider)

decision.reason: Added a CAS-style verified write owner over the existing per-file mutation queue: a second different owner is an explicit conflict, same-owner re-claim is idempotent, release requires a matching token, concurrent same-file writes serialize, and a thrown write rolls the claim back.

writeOwner.serialization: reuses withFileMutationQueue -> workspace fileMutation lease kernel (issue #167); no second scheduler
writeOwner.claim: first owner ok; different owner -> explicit 'owned-by-another-owner' with holder + conflict count; same owner -> idempotent reentrant
writeOwner.release: token-matched only; release clears the owner so a conflict is recoverable/rolled back
writeOwner.wrapper: withVerifiedWriteOwner serializes, claims, and releases in finally (no leak on throw)

residual.inProcess: The claim is an in-process coordination hint (same kernel as #167 leases); cross-process/cross-runtime writes are out of scope.
residual.assembly: The owner kernel is provided; wiring it to concrete hot-file write points is integration-layer work.
residual.scope: No second scheduler/platform; no default/lock/approval change.

independentVerification.detail: Tests drive the real claim/release API and the real withFileMutationQueue serialization (interleaving check) and assert rollback on throw. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: One verified owner at a time; a second different owner gets an explicit conflict with the holder, not a silent concurrent write.
A same-owner re-claim is idempotent (reentrant) and is not counted as a conflict.
Only a matching token releases; after release another owner can claim (conflict recovered).
Concurrent same-file writes serialize via the existing mutation queue (start/end never interleave); no active owner remains after completion.
A thrown write rolls back the owner claim (no leak).
Reuses the existing fileMutation lease kernel; no new scheduler/platform.
5 tests pass, tsgo:core 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.
